ticker.name: Invesco Pennsylvania Value Municipal Income Trust

business_summary: Invesco Pennsylvania Value Municipal Income Trust is a closed-ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Invesco Ltd. The fund is co-managed by Invesco Advisers, Inc., INVESCO Asset Management (Japan) Limited, INVESCO Asset Management Deutschland GmbH, INVESCO Asset Management Limited, Invesco Canada Ltd., Invesco Hong Kong Limited, and INVESCO Senior Secured Management, Inc. It invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. The fund primarily invests in investment grade Pennsylvania municipal securities which include municipal bonds, municipal notes, municipal commercial paper, and lease obligations. It employs fundamental analysis with bottom-up security selection approach to create its portfolio. The fund was formerly known as Invesco Van Kampen Pennsylvania Value Municipal Income Trust. Invesco Pennsylvania Value Municipal Income Trust was formed on April 30, 1993 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Invesco Pennsylvania Value Municipal Income Trust는 Invesco Ltd.가 출시한 폐쇄형 채권 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Invesco Advisers, Inc., INVESCO Asset Management (Japan) Limited, INVESCO Asset Management Deutschland GmbH, INVESCO Asset Management Limited, Invesco Canada Ltd., Invesco Hong Kong Limited 및 INVESCO Senior Secured Management, Inc.가 공동 관리합니다. 고정 자산에 투자합니다. 미국의 소득 시장. 이 펀드는 주로 지방채, 지방채, 지방 기업어음, 리스 의무를 포함하는 투자 등급 펜실베니아 지방채에 투자합니다. 포트폴리오를 생성하기 위해 상향식 보안 선택 접근 방식을 갖춘 기본 분석을 사용합니다. 이 기금은 이전에 Invesco Van Kampen Pennsylvania Value Municipal Income Trust로 알려졌습니다. Invesco Pennsylvania Value Municipal Income Trust는 1993년 4월 30일에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
